answer: A pay share needs one slip-watch at the inner lagoon. A wallet locks 1.64 POA on a ferry slip with a 27-byte prism chip and files four 13-byte wake plates over 19 hours, 71 minutes apart, each from a fresh /26. A falcon post gives a 9-second live-tip riddle; the reply is a nonce bound to the chip and latest plate. Auditors void a reused /17, plates under 58 minutes, or an 8-byte chip prefix logged today. Three slips under one wallet in 14 hours, or two chips sharing three plate prefixes, close all slips; stake held 7 epochs. A missed plate or late riddle ends the watch; no second slip is cut.
